decisions.candidate: D027 Biomedical vs D138 Biomedical Engineering
decisions.evidence: D027 is life/biological+environmental science (biologists, ecologists, biochemists, ISCO 2131/2133/3141); D138 is a general-engineering grab-bag (ISCO 2149/2141 renewable/materials/robotics/nuclear engineers). Only shared roles are generic environmental-science boilerplate; core professional function differs.

decisions.candidate: D059 Space Technology vs D132 Space Science, Exploration
decisions.evidence: D059 is actually aviation/aircraft ops (pilots, ATC, aircraft mechanics ISCO 3153/3154/7232, only 'astronaut' is space); D132 is physical/earth sciences (astronomers, cosmologists, geologists, physicists ISCO 2111/2114). Only overlap is generic industrial/process engineers.

decisions.candidate: D047 Agricultural Science vs D096 Agricultural
decisions.evidence: D047 is scientific/professional agriculture (agronomists, agri scientists, breeders, chemists ISCO 2131/2132/6112/6121); D096 is agricultural/land-based MACHINERY maintenance trade (ISCO 7233 mechanics, 8341 machine operators). Intentional academic-vs-vocational split, near-zero role overlap.

decisions.candidate: D055 Chemical Engineering vs D110 Chemical, Rubber
decisions.evidence: Heavy shared ISCO 8131 chemical-plant-operator block (~30 roles: soap/paint/nitrator/distillation). But D055 adds the professional 2145 chemical-engineer + 2131 bio-scientist tier; D110 adds distinct rubber/plastics/paper machine-operator trades (8141/8142/8143) absent from D055. Real profession-vs-broader-manufacturing boundary; shared 8131 block is over-fanout to trim.

decisions.candidate: D075 Fashion, Textiles vs D160 Fashion Styling, Image Consulting
decisions.evidence: D075 is garment/textile/footwear MANUFACTURING (tailors, patternmakers, sewing machinists, dyers, shoemakers ISCO 7531/7532/7533/8153/8156); D160 is a creative/beauty grab-bag (animators, graphic designers, make-up artists, beauticians, ISCO 2166/5142/3432) with only 'personal stylist' matching label. Different fields, ~0 overlap.

decisions.candidate: D078 Social Sciences vs D046 Social Work vs D128 Social Welfare, Youth Services
decisions.evidence: Three distinct functions/tiers: D078 = academic social-science RESEARCHERS (sociologist/economist/historian ISCO 2631/2632/2633); D046 = frontline social-work PRACTICE + counselling + care + clergy (2635/3412/2634/2636); D128 = social-service MANAGERS (ISCO 1341/1343/1344). D046 has absorbed ~15 D078 researcher roles as boilerplate but core practice function differs; D128 is the manager tier. All boundaries real.

decisions.candidate: D016 Electrical vs D093 Electrical Installation, Wiring vs D094 Electronics Servicing, ICT Equipment
decisions.evidence: Intentional academic-vs-vocational tiering across 3 distinct ISCO major groups: D016 = professional electrical/electronic ENGINEERS (2151/2152 + 3113 techs); D093 = electrician TRADE (7411/7412/7413 electricians, linesmen, cable jointers); D094 = electronics REPAIR/servicing trade (7421/7422 telecom, mobile/computer repair, avionics). Near-zero role overlap.

decisions.candidate: D026 Public Health vs D045 Public Administration
decisions.evidence: D026 is health-protection field (health&safety/food-safety inspectors, environmental health officers, public health physicians, disease surveillance ISCO 2263/3257/2267/2212); D045 is govt/civil-service administration (ministers, diplomats, policy officers, customs/police ISCO 1111/1112/2422/335x). Only shared role is 'public health policy officer'. Boundary real.

Mixes performing-arts talent (musicians/dancers/actors 2652/2653/2655), screen/broadcast production (directors/producers/editors/camera/sound 2654/3521) and live-event/theatre crew (stage/lighting/rigging/props 3435) — but all one field: entertainment/performance PRODUCTION. Talent+crew+mgmt co-work on same productions; this is seniority/work-type layering = SUB-GROUP problem, not two distinct fields. Recommend sub-groups: performing-arts / screen-broadcast / stage-live-event crew.

decisions.into: Hospitality, Food Service & Tourism | Retail Shop Management (move to D085)
decisions.evidence: Conflates two distinct fields: (1) genuine hospitality/food-service/tourism (chefs, cooks, waiters, bartenders, sommeliers, hotel/restaurant mgrs, cabin/ship stewards, tourist guides ISCO 3434/5120/5131/5132/5111/5113/1411/1431); (2) a ~45-role RETAIL shop-manager block (ISCO 1420: bakery/jewellery/clothing/supermarket/bookshop/pharmacy shop managers) that is retail management, not hospitality — belongs in D085 Retail Sales, Shop Operations. Distinct fields, distinct ISCO.
